Rankings_Without_Gifts.help: **Showing rankings of pairs after removing any gifted boards (NS, EW).**

prompts.sql: SELECT CONCAT(section_name, Pair_Number_NS, ' - ', Player_Name_N, ' - ', Player_Name_S) AS Pair_NS, AVG(CASE WHEN Score_NS <= Par_NS OR Score_NS <= EV_Max_NS THEN Pct_NS ELSE NULL END) AS Avg_Pct_NS, COUNT(CASE WHEN Score_NS <= Par_NS OR Score_NS <= EV_Max_NS THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Board_Count, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Score_NS > Par_NS AND Score_NS > EV_Max_NS THEN Board END, ', ') AS Gifted_Boards_Removed FROM self GROUP BY Pair_NS ORDER BY Avg_Pct_NS DESC, Board_Count DESC

SELECT CONCAT(section_name, Pair_Number_EW, ' - ', Player_Name_E, ' - ', Player_Name_W) AS Pair_EW, AVG(CASE WHEN Score_EW <= Par_EW OR Score_EW <= EV_Max_EW THEN Pct_EW ELSE NULL END) AS Avg_Pct_EW, COUNT(CASE WHEN Score_EW <= Par_EW OR Score_EW <= EV_Max_EW THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Board_Count, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Score_EW > Par_EW AND Score_EW > EV_Max_EW THEN Board END, ', ') AS Gifted_Boards_Removed FROM self GROUP BY Pair_EW ORDER BY Avg_Pct_EW DESC, Board_Count DESC

Overall_Rankings_Predictions.title: Overall Rankings Predictions
Overall_Rankings_Predictions.help: **Club rank and predicted club rank, FFBridge's published global rank and our predicted global rank, and the published and predicted session percentages. Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Pct, and the diffs are scratch, like the predictions. In a handicapped session, Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank, and Handicap_Global_Rank are FFBridge's figures with the IV bonus; they are blank when the session has no handicap. Each diff is actual minus predicted. A positive Pct_Diff means the pair scored above the prediction. A positive Rank_Diff means the pair finished lower than predicted, because a smaller rank is better. Club_Rank_Pred ranks predictions against the club's predictions; pairs with the same Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred share a place. Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred ranks the pair's prediction against the published percentages of the national field. Pct_Pred_SD is the prediction's standard deviation in percentage points, and Pct_Pred_Low to Pct_Pred_High is its 95% range; it narrows as more boards are played. Low_Confidence is true when either player had fewer than 20 earlier sessions (Min_Prior_Sessions is the smaller of the two counts), the pair had fewer than 5 earlier sessions together (Pair_Prior_Sessions), or the ratings are more than 30 days old. Ratings_Age_Days is filled only while the session is not yet in the Elo build: the predictions then use each player's latest rating, and Ratings_Age_Days is the age of the older of the pair's two ratings.**

prompts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(Section_Name, Pair_Number_NS, ' - ', Player_Name_N, ' - ', Player_Name_S) AS Pair, Club_Rank_NS AS Club_Rank, Club_Rank_Pred_NS AS Club_Rank_Pred, Global_Scratch_Rank_NS AS Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred_NS AS Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred, Rank_Diff_NS AS Rank_Diff, Global_Scratch_Pct_NS AS Global_Scratch_Pct, Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred_NS AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred, Pct_Diff_NS AS Pct_Diff, Handicap_Pct_NS AS Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank_NS AS Handicap_Club_Rank, Handicap_Global_Rank_NS AS Handicap_Global_Rank, Pct_Pred_SD_NS AS Pct_Pred_SD, Pct_Pred_Low_NS AS Pct_Pred_Low, Pct_Pred_High_NS AS Pct_Pred_High, Low_Confidence_NS AS Low_Confidence, Min_Prior_Sessions_NS AS Min_Prior_Sessions, Pair_Prior_Sessions_NS AS Pair_Prior_Sessions, Ratings_Age_Days_NS AS Ratings_Age_Days, Boards_NS AS Boards, 'NS' AS Orientation FROM self UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(Section_Name, Pair_Number_EW, ' - ', Player_Name_E, ' - ', Player_Name_W) AS Pair, Club_Rank_EW AS Club_Rank, Club_Rank_Pred_EW AS Club_Rank_Pred, Global_Scratch_Rank_EW AS Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred_EW AS Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred, Rank_Diff_EW AS Rank_Diff, Global_Scratch_Pct_EW AS Global_Scratch_Pct, Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred_EW AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred, Pct_Diff_EW AS Pct_Diff, Handicap_Pct_EW AS Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank_EW AS Handicap_Club_Rank, Handicap_Global_Rank_EW AS Handicap_Global_Rank, Pct_Pred_SD_EW AS Pct_Pred_SD, Pct_Pred_Low_EW AS Pct_Pred_Low, Pct_Pred_High_EW AS Pct_Pred_High, Low_Confidence_EW AS Low_Confidence, Min_Prior_Sessions_EW AS Min_Prior_Sessions, Pair_Prior_Sessions_EW AS Pair_Prior_Sessions, Ratings_Age_Days_EW AS Ratings_Age_Days, Boards_EW AS Boards, 'EW' AS Orientation FROM self ORDER BY Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank

fr.title: Prédictions du classement général
fr.help: **Classement au club et classement au club prédit, classement mondial publié par la FFBridge et notre classement mondial prédit, et pourcentages de la séance publié et prédit. Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Pct et les écarts sont en scratch, comme les prédictions. Dans une séance avec handicap, Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank et Handicap_Global_Rank sont les résultats de la FFBridge avec le bonus IV ; ils sont vides quand la séance n'a pas de handicap. Chaque écart est le réel moins le prédit. Un Pct_Diff positif signifie que la paire a fait mieux que la prédiction. Un Rank_Diff positif signifie que la paire a fini moins bien classée que prédit, car un rang plus petit est meilleur. Club_Rank_Pred classe les prédictions parmi celles du club ; les paires de même Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred partagent une place. Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred classe la prédiction de la paire parmi les pourcentages publiés du classement national. Pct_Pred_SD est l'écart type de la prédiction en points de pourcentage, et Pct_Pred_Low à Pct_Pred_High son intervalle à 95 % ; il se resserre quand plus de donnes sont jouées. Low_Confidence est vrai quand l'un des joueurs avait moins de 20 séances antérieures (Min_Prior_Sessions est le plus petit des deux nombres), quand la paire avait moins de 5 séances antérieures ensemble (Pair_Prior_Sessions), ou quand les classements ont plus de 30 jours. Ratings_Age_Days n'est rempli que tant que la séance n'est pas encore dans le calcul Elo : les prédictions utilisent alors le dernier classement de chaque joueur, et Ratings_Age_Days est l'âge du plus ancien des deux classements de la paire.**

Declarer_Direction_Predictions_Statistic.title: Declarer Direction Predictions Statistics Per Board
Declarer_Direction_Predictions_Statistic.help: **Statistics on declarer direction predictions per board number. Declarer_Direction lists the seats that actually declared at the tables given each prediction. Predictions made before game starts.**

prompts.sql: SELECT Board, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT Declarer_Direction, ', ' ORDER BY Declarer_Direction) AS Declarer_Direction, Declarer_Direction_Pred, COUNT() AS Board_Plays, SUM(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = Declarer_Direction_Pred THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Correct_Preds, CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('N','E','S','W') THEN Correct_Preds/Board_Plays END AS Correct_Direction_Pct, SUM(CASE WHEN (Declarer_Direction IN ('N','S') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('N', 'S')) OR (Declarer_Direction IN ('E','W') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('E', 'W')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Correct_Pair_Preds, CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('N','E','S','W') THEN Correct_Pair_Preds/Board_Plays END AS Correct_Pair_Pct FROM self GROUP BY Board, Declarer_Direction_Pred ORDER BY Board

Declarer_Direction_Predictions_Statistic.help: **Statistics on declarer direction predictions per predicted declarer. Predictions made before game starts.**
Declarer_Direction_Predictions_Statistic.comment: Only difference between this and above is Declared_Not_Predicted vs Predicted_Not_Declared. Learn how to combine.

prompts.sql: SELECT Declarer_Direction_Pred AS Player, COUNT() AS Pred_To_Declare, AVG(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = Declarer_Direction_Pred THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS Correct_Direction_Pct, AVG(CASE WHEN (Declarer_Direction IN ('N','S') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('N', 'S')) OR (Declarer_Direction IN ('E','W') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('E', 'W')) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS Correct_Pair_Pct, SUM(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = Declarer_Direction_Pred THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Correct_Preds, SUM(CASE WHEN (Declarer_Direction IN ('N','S') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('N', 'S')) OR (Declarer_Direction IN ('E','W') AND Declarer_Direction_Pred IN ('E', 'W')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Correct_Pair_Preds, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = Declarer_Direction_Pred THEN CAST(Board AS VARCHAR) END, ', ') AS Correctly_Pred_Boards, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction <> Declarer_Direction_Pred THEN CAST(Board AS VARCHAR) END, ', ') AS Predicted_Not_Declared FROM self GROUP BY Declarer_Direction_Pred ORDER BY Correct_Direction_Pct DESC, Pred_To_Declare DESC
